# Riemann Hypothesis / Weil Positivity — Roadmap

*Generated by pm-riemann on 2026-08-12 09:05. Manual edits will be overwritten on next sweep
— push back via OVERRIDE mail or by editing the PM config.*

**Where this stands, in one paragraph.** The corpus is inside Connes–Consani 2023, object for
object. There is no semilocal theorem — only the archimedean place is proved — so our objects
live in the branch whose theorem does not exist. Overnight that stopped being a liability and
became the contribution: `notes/deficit-repair.md` §6 states what a semilocal proof would have
to establish, as three constraints on *method*, and names a decay rate ($4\pi$) that
Connes–Consani plot as a figure and never identify. That is the "sharpening of the positivity
obstruction that stands on its own" `README.md` names as the fallback target.

## Trajectory

- **7d throughput:** 16 items, 2.40M output tokens, 218M total in. Riemann is third by volume
  behind pogo (116 items) and onethird (145, on hold) but produced its entire result set in
  one 5-hour window.
- **Cost of the result:** the four load-bearing tickets — mg-7606 (474k), mg-9433 (248k),
  mg-03f0 (223k), mg-3a9c (177k) — total 1.12M output, 47% of the product's 7d spend.
- **No bottleneck.** Every ticket filed overnight dispatched within 15 minutes and merged;
  zero refinery failures on riemann branches; CI clean; no open issues or PRs.
- **The real risk is not throughput, it is my framing.** Three of my ticket premises were
  wrong and were corrected by the work: a discriminator carrying one bit (mg-9433), a
  "decayed finding" that was a scoping defect (mg-6d7e), and "the deficit grows" when it is
  bounded (mg-7606). Each ticket now carries an explicit instruction to reject its premise
  and say so early. That is working — but it means ticket premises should be read as
  hypotheses, not as findings.

## Gaps I'm watching

- **Not one line of this has been read by a mathematician.** Every result is
  agent-produced and agent-checked. The self-audits are good (`citation-audit.md` §9,
  `deficit-repair.md` §1.4 and §8 distinguish reproduction from verification and name
  what would do most damage if wrong) — but that is internal consistency, not review.
- **`deficit-repair.md`'s numerics are one implementation.** The $4\pi$ agreement, the
  $5.3722$ bound and the reversed signs on the near-radical direction have not been
  reproduced by an independent code path.
- **arXiv-only literature coverage.** Two of Connes' own pages 403'd.
- Six notes, heavy line-anchored cross-referencing, no assembled narrative. Every further
  edit risks the anchors; every further result raises the consolidation cost.
